aboutText: Anantha Lakshmi Institute of Technology and Sciences (ALITS), established in 2008 by the visionary Anantha Lakshmi Educational Society under the dynamic stewardship of Sri M. Anantha Ramudu (Founder & Chairman), stands as a beacon of academic excellence in the Rayalaseema region.

Spanning over 54 acres of serene, lush-green campus along the Ananthapur - Chennai Highway, ALITS is an Autonomous Institution accredited with NAAC 'A' Grade and NBA accreditation for core engineering programs. ALITS offers 9 specialized engineering & diploma disciplines, nurturing over 5,800 students with state-of-the-art innovation labs, skill development directorate, digital libraries, and 100% placement support.

chairman.message: Education has always been considered a noble profession for it is a process that helps to condition the human mind in its formative years, provide a meaning and purpose in life and enable youth to choose an avenue that will lead to their future career path. I strongly believe that education not only sculpts a good human being but also inculcates a sense of responsibility with principles and values towards society. To assure value-based education we established Anantha Lakshmi Institute of Technology & Sciences in 2008. ALITS basically aims at achieving excellence in the key areas of engineering and to produce talented and committed human resource driven by the spirit of innovation and teamwork. We offer under – graduate and post – graduate programmes in Engineering and Management for many students from all parts of India. I would like to thank the generation of parents who have entrusted us with the care and education of their children. It is their faith and belief in ALITS that facilities us come this far..
chairman.name: Sri M. Anantha Ramudu
chairman.profile: Industrialist, Philanthropist, and Visionary Educationist who founded ALITS to bring world-class technical education to rural and urban youth in Andhra Pradesh.
chairman.title: Founder & Chairman

principal.message: ALITS Autonomous curriculum & examination system is crafted with rigorous standards to ensure continuous evaluation, transparency, and academic excellence.
principal.name: Dr. K. Sreenivasulu, M.Tech, Ph.D.
principal.profile:
RenowDr. K. Sreenivasulu, completed his B.E., in Computer Science and Engineering from SJCIT Chickballapur (Bangalore University), M.Tech., from JNTU College Engineering Anantapur India and Ph.D., from JNTUK University, Kakinada. He is having an excellent academic track throughout, he came into the academics 25 years.

Prior to joining Ananta Lakshmi Institute of Technology & Sciences Anantapur as the Principal in 2025, served in the capacity of Controller of Examinations, G.Pullaiah College of Engineering and Technology, Kurnool A.P. till Dec 2024, for 8 years and as a Principal, Head of the Department of CSE at Madina Engineering College Kadapa for more than 18 years.

He has widely published 20 Journal articles in reputed international journals, has presented 10 conference papers around the globe, and is a reviewer for international journals and publishing houses. As a research supervisor, 2 research scholars are pursuing their Ph.D., under his guidance in JNTUA. Apart from these, he has been the resource person to many workshops, conferences and faculty development programmes and conducted a number of conferences, workshops and pedagogic training programmes. He is the member of Professional Bodies like MIE , MISTE,ned Academician, Chief Controller of Examinations, and Researcher with over 25 years of administrative experience. Author of 60+ Scopus indexed international journal papers.
principal.title: Principal & Chief Controller of Examinations

viceChairman.message:
From the bottom of my heart I extend my heartfelt gratitude for considering Anantha Lakshmi Institute of Technology & Sciences. ALITS has witnessed an unparalleled growth in academic and professional stature and will continue to add new dimensions leaving no stone unturned.

Here we have an excellent faculty committed to quality teaching, a flexible curriculum responsive to the changing needs of the industry, excellent computer facilities, best-in-class infrastructure, and a well stocked library to contribute to the excellence of our undergraduate, postgraduate and management programmes.

In ALTS you get a chance to associate with other motivated students, experienced and dedicated faculty, corporate go-getters and excellent placement opportunities that best suit for your skills and qualifications.

We believe in human aspirations, social responsibilities, services and ethical values. We are confident that our students are assets to the society.

We cordially invite you to visit our campus. I hope you will find this inspiring introduction to the opportunities that await you at our college.
viceChairman.name: Sri M. Ramesh Naidu
viceChairman.profile: M. Ramesh Naidu, son of Chairman Sri Anantha Ramudu, is the Vice Chairman of Anantha Lakshmi Institute of technology & Sciences. He did his B.Tech. in ECE at SriVidya Nikethan Engineering college at Tirupathi. He pursued M.S in USA at the University of New Havens, Connecticut State. He worked as a Senior Software Engineer in Edison, New jersey. Due to his strong passion for education and strong wish to bring quality education he came back to India in 2008 and determined to work as a Vice Chairman of Anantha Lakshmi Institute of Technology & Sciences, established by his father, Sri Anantha Ramudu. From the day of inception he has been looking after all the growth and development of the college, and actively involving in each and every progressive activities in the college. As a Vice Chairman of the college he shouldered a responsibility which is to bring quality education to the students so as to enable them to become employable.
viceChairman.title: Vice-Chairman
